svg.aria-label: Week 5 Day 1 hero: cultural globalisation. A large globe sits in the middle of a world street, with paper planes, a film strip, music notes and wi-fi waves orbiting it. On the left, grey identical shop fronts with the same burger sign repeat — homogenization. On the right, a colourful street mixes red lanterns, a fusion food truck selling dumpling tacos, a young woman in a hanfu jacket with sneakers and headphones, and music notes — hybridization. Two signs read “Homogenization” and “Hybridization”.
